archetypes.name: dyn-coverage-safety
archetypes.rationale: Validate fail-closed identity checks and incremental coverage advancement in _note_consumable and _advance_note_coverage
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the incremental coverage advancement in _advance_note_coverage and _note_consumable in python/larch/core/architectural_guidelines.py. Verify that AUTHORED_DIFF_FINGERPRINT is never overwritten during advancement, that the atomic snapshot/fingerprint/HEAD_SHA refresh is correct, and that every unsafe path (git errors, malformed output, invalid revisions, symlinks, missing files) returns False. Check that prior-format metadata fallback correctly derives both identities from DIFF_FINGERPRINT. Confirm that the validators in validate_guideline_ship_outcome_record and validate_invariant_ship_outcome_record accept exactly the new deterministic-clean and unavailable combinations and reject all invalid pairings. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
